theorem_title: Finite bound for physical catalog expansion
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingCatalogExpand.time_bound {h J k t : ℕ} (hk : k < J) (ht : t ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.LightBlockQuery.residualSize h J (k+1)+1) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingCatalogExpand.time h J k t ≤
      25000*(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockQuery.width h J+1)^3*(_root_.ThreeSum.LightSparseQuery.queryItems (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBlockQuery.residualSize h J (k+1)) t+1)*(_root_.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.groupSize h+1) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k,t\in\mathbb N$, with $k<J$ and $t\le r(h,J,k+1)+1$, where $r$ is the next-level residual-size parameter. Write $W$ for global query width, $Q(r,t)$ for the sparse-query item count and $G(h)$ for the local child count. Then

$$T_{\mathrm{expand}}(h,J,k,t)\le25000(W+1)^3\bigl(Q(r,t)+1\bigr)(G(h)+1).$$

This bounds actual parent expansion by the finite query and child counts used in the complete runtime ledger.
